postData.contentHtml:
Pirueto is a 2D physics motorbike game about balance, timing and speed. It is now available on Google Play for Android and on itch.io for Windows and Linux.

Your bike is springy and elastic: lean back to pop a wheelie, lean forward to stay down on steep climbs, and spin in mid-air to land on both wheels. The goal is simple: collect every coin, then reach the flag. Getting there is the hard part.

More than just hills

  • Nitro for a timed burst of speed
  • Mud that slides under your wheels
  • Dogs that chase you down
  • Balloons that carry you up to ride upside down
  • Gravity coins that turn the world around: ride the ceiling or up a wall
  • Spikes, low roofs, caves and tunnels

Beat your best

  • Your three best times on every level
  • Race against the ghost of your best run
  • Watch your best runs again in Replays: pause, slow down and scrub

The game has 54 levels. 14 of them are free; the other 40 come in the Full Throttle pack (an in-app purchase on Android, the full game on itch.io). It is translated into 14 languages and plays offline.

Under the hood

Pirueto is written in Rust. The physics engine is custom and deterministic, so the same inputs always produce the same ride on every platform, which is what makes ghosts and replays possible.

Get it

  • Android: Google Play
  • Windows and Linux: itch.io

If you try it, I would like to hear what you think.
postData.title: Pirueto: a 2D physics motorbike game
